key_fields.name: CC-WORK-AREA
key_fields.meaning: Common card/account work area initialized at task start.

key_fields.name: CCARD-AID
key_fields.meaning: Normalized attention key with 88-levels CCARD-AID-ENTER, -CLEAR, -PA1, -PA2 and -PFK01..-PFK12, set by YYYY-STORE-PFKEY.

key_fields.name: CCARD-AID-PFK05
key_fields.meaning: PF5; COACTUPC uses it as the save confirmation key.

key_fields.name: CCARD-AID-PFK12
key_fields.meaning: PF12; COACTUPC uses it to cancel changes and re-read the account.

key_fields.name: CCARD-NEXT-PROG
key_fields.meaning: Next program name recorded by the screen handler.

key_fields.name: CCARD-ERROR-MSG
key_fields.meaning: 75-byte error message area; COACTUPC copies WS-RETURN-MSG here.

key_fields.name: CC-ACCT-ID
key_fields.meaning: 11-character account id entered on the screen, with numeric redefinition CC-ACCT-ID-N; key for the cross-reference and account reads.

key_fields.name: CC-CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: 16-character card number with numeric redefinition; not referenced by COACTUPC.

key_fields.name: CC-CUST-ID
key_fields.meaning: 9-character customer id with numeric redefinition; not referenced by COACTUPC.

observations.text: Several former fields (CCARD-LAST-PROG, CCARD-RETURN-TO-PROG, CCARD-RETURN-FLAG, CCARD-FUNCTION) are commented out; the lines carry sequence numbers in columns 1-6 and 73-80.

purpose: Defines CC-WORK-AREAS, the common working storage of the card and account online programs: the normalized attention key CCARD-AID with its 88-levels, next program/mapset/map, error and return message areas, and the account, card and customer ids keyed on the screen. COACTUPC uses CCARD-AID for key handling, CC-ACCT-ID as the account key and CCARD-ERROR-MSG for the error message.
